KohYao Luxury Beachfront TreeHouse Villas Resort Near Phuket
TreeHouse Villas Koh Yao
5-star Luxurious TreeHouse Villas with Secluded Beach
The Original Luxury TreeHouse Experience in Asia
‘Designed by craftsmen, inspired by nature capturing the true essence of island luxury’
While the distinctive design of TreeHouse Villas is a key part of their appeal, it is the pristine natural environment that truly defines    the essence of this original TreeHouse concept in Asia.
Here, nature is not just a backdrop — it is the foundation upon which this unique resort experience was created.
Nestled among ancient jungle and overlooking the emerald waters of Phang Nga Bay,
TreeHouse Villas Koh Yao is not a resort built in nature, but one born from it .
Its architecture rises organically from the landscape, blending seamlessly with the island’s raw beauty.
Luxury here is redefined — not through excess, but through connection.
Every elevated villa, every open-air space, and every quiet corner pays tribute to the surroundings that make this place so original.       This is the true spirit of the TreeHouse concept in Asia harmonious blend of design, nature, and authenticity that fulfils the soul.

pages.text:
Koh Yao TreeHouse Villa Luxury Beach Resort Near Phuket
TreeHouse Villa
An Exceptional Exclusive Space for Two
TreeHouse Villa
Grand King-Sized Bed
100 sqm
2 adults
Hammock Bathtub
Private Plunge Pool
Stunning Sea Views
Enter our signature TreeHouse Villa with a suspended bridge. The lower floor is open-aired and features a plunge pool which reaches into the jungle itself. It comes complete with a private dining facility, personal bar, a double swing, day beds, and high ceilings all decorated in a modern vintage style using up-cycled and recycled materials and a colour palette inspired from the jungle and sea.
Book Your Villa
In the airconditioned upper floor, the grand king-sized bed faces a balcony which sits above the trees giving the feeling of floating over the leafy canopy and providing views over the sea to the Jurassic massifs of the bay. A large custom hammock-shaped bath, ‘jungle shower’ and changing room provide a delight to guests. A second personal bar and another day bed for further comfort and relaxation following the same colour and furniture scheme are highlight the lower floor. An exceptional space for two.
